name: openscad
summary: Script-first solid-modeling tool for parametric 3D geometry generation and export.
why_it_matters: OpenSCAD keeps useful programmatic CAD capability knowledge in the repo, but there is no current validated workflow that justifies active maintenance.
when_to_use: A future scenario needs scriptable parametric geometry generation.
Operators want reproducible CAD output without GUI-driven modeling.
The workflow depends on CAD-as-code rather than interactive design.

platform_support.notes: OpenSCAD itself is portable and can run in containers, but rendering and file workflows still vary by host setup.

prerequisites: Validated CLI or container execution path
Artifact storage for models and renders
Defined script input and output conventions
implementation_notes: Promotion should focus on validated render/export workflows instead of full editor support.
Keep script execution and artifact handling explicit.
Do not retain speculative CAD wrappers without an active scenario.
operational_notes: Validation should include a minimal model render or export.
Version pinning matters for geometry reproducibility.
Artifacts can be deterministic if inputs are controlled carefully.
risks: CAD wrappers add little value without real generated design workflows.
Container or CLI availability alone does not prove useful support.
